title: Because Thy Mercy Is So Great
description: Because Thy Mercy Is So Great in Tonic Solfa to WINCHESTER NEW, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the East (Paisley, in print by 1911).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Long Metre (8.8.8.8), and this page sets them to WINCHESTER NEW; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Be-cause Thy mer-cy is so great, Lord, think up-on my nee-dy state, And deign to give the help I need, The Bread of Life my soul to feed.

lines: Because Thy mercy is so great,
Lord, think upon my needy state,
And deign to give the help I need, —
The Bread of Life my soul to feed.
They cannot live whose souls are fed
On what this foolish world calls bread;
For lack of food the spirit sighs,
And, weak and weary, faints and dies.
O may the hidden manna give
The strength I need that I may live;
And may that life be spent for Thee
Who came and lived on earth for me.
O Jesus Christ, the living Bread,
Now at the table Thou hast spread,
Think of me in my utmost need,
And let me on Thy bounties feed.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the East (by 1911)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the East; set to WINCHESTER NEW by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
